text:
lina (Account Exec): hey finance team — quick ask. CoveHealth is mid-contract and hit a major usage shift. they want a temporary SKU rate reduction for the next 6 months while they ramp new feature traffic. can we do a one-off pricing waiver + a small retro credit to keep them from churning?
rohan (Sales Ops): adding context: customer currently on committed Dedicated plan, monthly committed tokens ~450M. recent forecast shows drop to ~250M for 3 months then ramp back. legal ok with an amendment. margin hit if we keep old rates.
lina (Account Exec): proposed concession: one-time onboarding credit $12,500 + reduce per-token rate from $0.0036 -> $0.0028 for 6 months (applies to usage above committed floor). revenue ops asked us to route to finance for approval. tag: @maya
maya (Finance): thanks — need revenue impact and expiry rules. are we doing this as a permanent repricing or temporary amendment? any precedent? also need GL coding for the credit.
lina (Account Exec): temporary amendment only, auto-revert after 6 months. precedent: we did similar for Nimbus last year (see ticket 2214567890). legal will sign an amendment.
alex (RevOps): can you drop quick delta calc? helps speed review. also need SFDC deal note and amended order form attached before we apply credit.
lina (Account Exec): sure — quick calc below (rounded):
```
current_rate = 0.0036
proposed_rate = 0.0028
monthly_tokens = 450000000
expected_tokens_during_reduction = 250000000
delta_per_token = current_rate - proposed_rate # 0.0008
monthly_savings = delta_per_token * expected_tokens_during_reduction
monthly_savings = 0.0008 * 250,000,000 = $200,000
6_month_savings = $1,200,000
one_time_credit = $12,500
net_6mo_impact = one_time_credit + (monthly_savings * -1) -> revenue decreases by ~$1,212,500
```
note: saving to customer is large but most months usage sits under committed floor historically; this applies only to incremental usage beyond floor. i'll attach contract lines in SFDC.
rohan (Sales Ops): FYI the committed floor stays the same; amendment language ensures usage credit only triggers on incremental usage.
maya (Finance): ok that calc is helpful. curious on the 'incremental only' clause — need exact language before approval. also request: amortize the $12.5k credit over 3 months for ARR/cash reporting and provide GL bucket (promo-credits-2026).
alex (RevOps): i'll create a Jira ops ticket to implement rate override and track the amendment. ticket: https://jira.redwoodinfra/OPS-7891 
lina (Account Exec): added the legal amendment draft to SFDC + internal notes. link: https://sales.redwood/opp/CH-4820 (private).
maya (Finance): decision: approve one-time $12,500 promo credit and temporary per-token rate 0.0028 for 6 months provided: 1) amendment signed, 2) explicit incremental-only clause included, 3) GL code promo-credits-2026 used, 4) RevOps ticket OPS-7891 created and linked to the order. tagging @alex for implementation. Approving on a conditional basis :white_check_mark:
lina (Account Exec): thank you!! will get amendment signed and attach to SFDC. will confirm once signed. :pray:
credit-bot: Auto-note: once finance confirms in Jira, apply credit and schedule rate override for 2026-05-01 -> 2026-10-31 window.
alex (RevOps): noted — will not apply until signed amendment & GL confirmed. will update OPS-7891 when live.
maya (Finance): closing loop — once OPS ticket shows amendment attached and GL set, finance will run final sign-off and instruct billing to apply credit.
lina (Account Exec): great — i'll ping when doc is signed.
rohan (Sales Ops): thanks everyone. keeping this thread for audit. :lock:
